summary.text: Helene Duhamel is a Republican state senator from South Dakota's District 32 who took office on December 3, 2019, after Gov. Kristi Noem appointed her to fill the vacancy left by Alan Solano's resignation.
She advanced from the June 2, 2026, Republican primary and faces Democrat Jeff Shelton in the November 3 general election.

paragraphs.text: Duhamel chaired the Senate Judiciary Committee in the 2023-2024 session.
In the 2025-2026 session she serves on the Senate Agriculture and Natural Resources and Judiciary committees and is vice chair of the Senate Local Government Committee.
